I couldn't write these notes. My tools hit their usage limit before any page loaded, so I haven't read a single source on Psalm 44. Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, with a URL for every point. If I wrote notes now, they would come from my own memory without real citations, so I haven't written any.

I had planned to read these pages first (none have been checked yet):

- **Verse-by-verse (traditional reading):** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-44/; the Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit and Barnes commentaries on Psalm 44 at biblehub.com; preceptaustin.org's Psalm 44 page
- **Baptist:** Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* on Psalm 44, at spurgeon.org or studylight.org
- **Modern scholarship:** the netbible.org notes on Psalm 44
- **Catholic:** Augustine's exposition at newadvent.org. His Bible numbers this psalm 43, not 44.
- **Romans 8:36:** Paul quotes v. 22 there. That verse is probably where the traditions' readings will differ most, so I'd also look for Reformed, Lutheran and Wesleyan pages on it.

If you ask again in a new message, my tools should be available again and I'll go through these sources and write the verse-by-verse notes as you described.
